properties.Description: Non-Core MAP schema for first-class Visualizer Holons, their executable realizations, and type-based applicability. Capability taxonomies, compatibility/release contracts, Visualizer Commons stewardship, and dynamic acquisition are deliberately deferred.

Transient response-body projection containing an opaque handle to one Rust-authorized executable realization of a selected Visualizer Holon. The module source remains in the artifact backend and is retrieved through the artifact command boundary.
Dance response wrapping a transient MaterializedVisualizer projection.
Visualizer-afforded dance that retrieves one executable realization without making frontend caches an authority.
properties.DanceDescription: Materializes executable code for one selected Visualizer Holon through the Rust-owned artifact backend.

properties.Description: Meta-type for Visualizer Holon Type descriptors. It identifies the descriptor family whose instances are DAHN Visualizer Holons and provides a semantic target for Visualizer-role composition and discovery.

Abstract family anchor for DAHN Visualizer Holon Types. Ordinary Visualizer Holons must be described by concrete descendants; their semantic identity is distinct from executable implementation identities. A Visualizer defines its semantic Slots and owns the presentation strategy that dynamically composes them within the allocation supplied by its parent.
A coherent experience container bound to one MetaDesignSystem. It may contain only Visualizers that support that system.
Concrete Visualizer Holon Type for visualizers that compose a canvas experience.
Concrete Visualizer Holon Type for visualizers that represent individual holons.
Concrete Visualizer Holon Type for visualizers that realize a multi-Holon semantic structure organized by a topology.
Structure Visualizer subkind for interaction-derived navigation rooted at one Holon.
Concrete Visualizer Holon Type for visualizers that represent holon collections.
Concrete Visualizer Holon Type for visualizers that represent a set of Properties within one presentation strategy.
Concrete Visualizer Holon Type for visualizers that compose one descriptor-defined property name with a selected Value Visualizer. It does not own set-level layout.
Concrete Visualizer Holon Type for visualizers that represent values.
Concrete Visualizer Holon Type for visualizers that represent actions.
Concrete Visualizer Holon Type for visualizers that represent graph-oriented views.

Concrete semantic identity for one executable realization of a Visualizer Holon. Its runtime and stable implementation key support static resolution without making a client registry semantic authority. Acquisition, compatibility, and implementation-private behavior are deferred.

Semantic role within a Visualizer's composition that declares one or more accepted Visualizer Holon Type roles. It does not encode runtime occupancy or spatial geometry; selection and occupancy are recorded through VisualizerUsage.

A context-owned use of a selected Visualizer to fulfill a VisualizerSlot. It separates shared Visualizer capability from future circumstance, configuration, and selection-history state without defining those extensions yet.
Relates a Visualizer Holon to one or more executable realization identities without making any realization the Visualizer's durable semantic identity.
Inverse of ImplementedBy. Each first-cut VisualizerImplementation realizes exactly one Visualizer Holon.

Declares a descriptor Type against which a selector evaluates a Visualizer Holon's applicability using its type lineage. Node and Properties visualizers target HolonType lineages; Property and Value visualizers may target PropertyType and ValueType lineages.
Inverse of ApplicableToType, exposing the Visualizer Holons applicable to a descriptor Type.
Declares the semantic VisualizerSlots that a Visualizer requires for its internal composition.
Inverse of HasSlot. Each first-cut VisualizerSlot belongs to exactly one Visualizer.

Declares one or more Visualizer Holon Type roles accepted by a semantic Slot. Its cardinality applies to accepted role declarations, not runtime occupancy; the selected Visualizer is bound through a VisualizerUsage.
Inverse of AcceptsVisualizerType, exposing the semantic slots that accept a Visualizer Holon Type role.
Identifies the shared Visualizer capability used by one context-owned VisualizerUsage.
Inverse of UsesVisualizer, exposing context-owned usages of a shared Visualizer.
Binds a context-owned VisualizerUsage to the VisualizerSlot it fulfills without making the Slot select a concrete Visualizer directly.
Inverse of FillsVisualizerSlot, exposing the context-owned usages through which a Slot is fulfilled.
Runtime in which a VisualizerImplementation is executable; the initial runtime set is intentionally small and extensible.
Stable symbolic key by which a statically bundled runtime may resolve a VisualizerImplementation to executable code.
Opaque, host-scoped artifact capability returned by MaterializeVisualizer. It is not a filesystem path, URL, or content identifier and is valid only at the artifact command boundary.
Content digest for the executable artifact of a VisualizerImplementation. The value is encoded as algorithm:hex and is verified by the host artifact backend before issuing a handle.
Executable module format declared by a VisualizerImplementation and returned with its materialized artifact handle.
Initial execution runtime variants supported by VisualizerImplementation identities; future runtime variants may be added without changing semantic Visualizer identity.
A TypeScript implementation bundled with a DAHN client.
A Rust implementation available to the MAP host runtime.
Binds a Canvas to the one MetaDesignSystem that governs all contained Visualizers and Theme selection.
Inverse of UsesMetaDesignSystem.
Contains a Visualizer whose supported MetaDesignSystems include the Canvas's one UsesMetaDesignSystem target.
Inverse of ContainsVisualizer.
Declares the small semantic set of DesignTokens a Visualizer consumes.
Inverse of ConsumesDesignToken.
